text:
ella: Heads-up: I noticed inconsistent param names across docs+SDK. migration guide uses `model_variant`, SDK examples use `model`. This will confuse migrations. Can we standardize and add glossary text?
nate: We should standardize on `model` and put variants in the value (e.g., `redwood/guanaco-7b-q4`). Easier for discoverability and matches REST.
jin: Agreed. I'll update the migration guide language (soften the tone too) and fix a broken link at line ~40.
ella: Can someone write a tiny glossary entry (2 sentences) defining family vs variant vs profile? Also a one-line example for usage.
ate: I'll take the SDK snippet changes — will replace `model_variant` with `model` in examples and add `# include variant in value` comment. Will run unit snippets tests.
docs-bot: Link/lint check queued on branch docs/param-cleanup-1790. Found 1 broken link in /docs/guides/migration.md -> https://old.example.com/migrate (404).
jin: Replace with `/docs/guides/migration#migrating-params`. I'll push the change. Also, migration guide: change "you must" -> "we recommend" unless it's a breaking removal.
qa: Quick note: update the SDK changelog entry mentioning the param rename and migration one-liner.
ella: Draft glossary blurb: "model family: base model name (e.g., guanaco-7b). variant: packaging/quant suffix (e.g., -q4). profile: serving profile mapping to runtime choices (e.g., low-latency). Example: model='redwood/guanaco-7b-q4'  # variant in value."
nate: Nice. Drop that in a glossary PR and ping me.
jin: PRs incoming: docs/glossary-1790 and sdk/examples-1790. Tagging @qa @nate for review.
docs-bot: CI will run link checks after merges.
ella: Thanks all — I'll close once both PRs are merged.
